source_quote: 我希望打开自动上传到youtube中，我再项目上传部分写清楚的，请你去看看项目中，我是否写清楚了。且对于之前没有上传的内容，也即是素材库中没有链接youtube内容的视频，都进行重传，因为这是上传必须要的内容。

observations.actual_recent_import_receipt: Returned material_id, video_r2_url, thumbnail and sharing; no upload-task ID or enqueue acknowledgment.
observations.known_browser_history: Separate historical web receipts do contain actual task_id and material/resource identity. Their existence does not prove a recent R2 import enqueued anything.

root_cause: The local import/verification handler assigned requested_not_verified unconditionally, without actual enqueue evidence. The remote internal branch behavior is not independently established.
recovery_scope: All 63 missing-link uploader-owned videos; preserve existing IDs, bindings, attribution, tags and raw records. Recover or create only the required YouTube handoff through a supported existing-material entry point. Do not blindly duplicate a queued/unknown task.
limits: Read-only audit does not create or retry upload tasks.
The 63 missing URLs are not by themselves proof of failed tasks; one material remains video-upload and needs task reconciliation.
No claim of YouTube completion, independent video quality acceptance, paid media call or remote server repair.
